For Each.title: A Repeater that meets something it cannot build stops for good — a Template the project does not have, or Items holding a null when it rebuilds — and no later Items, Template or Refresh is ever drawn or answered
A Repeater's Items Rendered fires after every run of its queue, including one that built nothing — at load with no Items bound, after a Refresh that failed, after a Dynamic rebuild with no Script
For Each.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as recommended: "Fire it only when rows were added or removed". A list cleared to empty still fires it, because rows were removed.

For Each.title: Items holding a null keep a Repeater's old rows on screen, and a Refresh, Template or Template Type change made after it in the same frame is lost — with every later Refresh, which is never answered again
For Each.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as leaned: "Skip the empty entry and report it once". Every other row is drawn.

For Each.title: A list whose items repeat an id draws that item's row after the row that follows it, and every later copy of the same list (a Refresh) takes that row down and builds it again
For Each.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as recommended: "One row per id, at the first item's place, kept across a Refresh".

For Each.title: A Repeater Script that sets `component` to something that is not text (a number, an object, `true`) stops the Repeater for good — no later Items, Template or Refresh is drawn or answered
For Each.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as recommended: "Skip that item and report an error". The same as a Script that throws.

For Each.title: With Template Type Explicit and no Template, a Refresh reports Done (and draws nothing) once any Script has compiled — without one it fails `repeater/no-template`
For Each.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as recommended: "Fail with "no template" whenever Explicit has no Template". The check reads only what Template Type uses.

For Each.title: A Repeater Refresh pulsed while a rebuild is running is never answered — no Done, no Failure — although a rebuild runs for it
For Each.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as recommended: "Answer it when its own rebuild finishes". What the code's comment says it meant: every Refresh gets exactly one answer, from the rebuild it asked for.

For Each.title: A Repeater input mapping (Script under Input Mapping) that throws for a record stops the Repeater for good — that row and every later one is never drawn, and no Refresh is answered

A Repeater input mapping that throws when a record changes throws into whatever wrote the record — another node's Set, a backend's save, a Query — which fails there, though the fault is the Repeater's

A Repeater reports the signals of several rows that fire in the same update as ONE — the last row's Item Id, the first row's outputs, the last row's signal — so every row's Added after the first is lost, and a row's Leaving is reported as another row's Added
A row a Repeater adds while another row is on its way out (its Try Remove waiting, or its removal not yet run) lands one place early and stays there; a Refresh moves the leaving row to the end

Page Stack.title: A push, replace or Reset to a page whose component the project does not have is never answered — the caller's Navigate hangs with no Done and no Failure
A push with a transition the stack does not know (a wired Transition such as "Fade") is never answered, and the page it built is dropped
A Components value that is not a list blanks the stack and its Reset is never answered; a page looked up by its label whose component was never set throws the same way
A Reset during a back's animation empties the stack: the animation's end takes the new start page off it, and every push after is never answered
A Pop whose page below is no longer in the Components list throws: the pusher hears the results and the page below comes back, but the stack never pops
A reset that finds no components (or no start page) deletes every page but leaves Top Component Name and Stack Depth naming what was there
Writing a Component Stack's Name — even the name it already has — rebuilds it at its start page, losing every page pushed
A Component Stack mounted again at a frame sends no Children Count in that frame — the page it builds is counted a frame late
The browser's Back or Forward sends every Component Stack on the page back to its start page, Use Routes or not
With Use Routes, a Pop pushes the page below as a new history entry, so the browser's Back then shows the page just popped, as the only page, with a Pop that does nothing
Page Stack.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as leaned: "A Pop steps the browser's history back". The app's Back and the browser's Back then agree.

Page Stack.title: With Use Routes in hash mode, pushing a page with no parameters keeps the previous page's query in the address, and a reload or Back hands it those parameters
With Use Routes, a page's parameters go into the URL's query unencoded: a value with &, #, + or a space comes back different, and one with % empties the stack at the next reset
With Use Routes, a page pushed (or started) by its label rather than its id gets no URL: the address becomes #, and a reload or Back shows the start page
With Use Routes, a URL whose query or path parameter has a malformed escape (%zz) empties the Component Stack, and its Reset is never answered
A Component Stack page whose Path is wired null empties the stack at every reset that reaches it
With Use Routes, a Component Stack's Reset (and a Components edit) rebuilds the page in the URL, not the start page its Reset port promises
Page Stack.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as leaned: "Reset goes to the start page and writes its address". As the Reset input's description says. Loading the page and the browser's Back still read the address.

Page Stack.title: A Component Stack turned off with Mounted and back on comes back at its start page — the pages pushed, and anything typed on them, are gone; ruled: keep them when an option is ticked
Page Stack.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), against the lean: "Keep them only when an option is ticked".

PageStackNavigate.title: Push Component To Stack never answers a press when Mode is neither push nor replace
PageStackNavigate.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Fail and name the value". The press fires Failure with an error such as "Unknown mode 'Push'", so the author sees what their wire sent.

PageStackNavigateToPath.title: Navigate To Path never answers a press when Path is not text (null, a number) — the frame-end callback throws
PageStackNavigateToPath.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Treat it as no path". Failure fires with 'No path to navigate to', the same as a missing Path today. A one-line change.

PageStackNavigateToPath.title: Navigate To Path never answers a press when the browser refuses the push (a Path on another origin with the Path URL type)
PageStackNavigateToPath.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Report a clear failure".

PageStackNavigateToPath.title: Navigate To Path expands $&, $$ and friends inside a parameter value
PageStackNavigateToPath.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Insert values as written". Any value, dollar signs included, lands in the address unchanged. One line in one place, the same fix as String Format's.

PageStackNavigateToPath.title: Navigate To Path does not encode Query values — a value with & or # breaks the URL
PageStackNavigateToPath.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Encode, and skip null". Any text travels safely and arrives unchanged, because the router already decodes what it reads.

Radio Button Group.title: A Radio Button Group's Value written back in the same frame as a person's pick leaves the picked button selected under a Value that names another — picking it again raises nothing, and picking the named one raises no Changed
Radio Button Group.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Show what Value says". The buttons read the group's Value directly, so every write redraws them and the next pick fires Changed.

A Navigate with no Router name, pressed while no Page Router is on the page, waits for good — a router registering as Main never takes it

net.noodl.ParseFeed.title: Parse Feed's dates depend on where it runs, and a CEST or BST date is published hours wrong
net.noodl.ParseFeed.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "UTC, and no date if unknown". A date with no timezone is read as UTC everywhere, and an unknown name such as CEST gives no date. A small change in one function.

net.noodl.ParseFeed.title: Parse Feed's Feed Updated keeps the previous feed's date when the next feed has none
net.noodl.ParseFeed.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Send empty text". Feed Updated goes blank, as its siblings do. A one-line change.

net.noodl.ParseFeed.title: Parse Feed shows Count 2 and one item when a feed repeats a guid — and the item is the second one
net.noodl.ParseFeed.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Match Count, describe sharing". Count says how many items Items really holds, and the Items description says each item is the shared record of its id.

net.noodl.ParseXML.title: Parse XML goes silent — no Result, no Failure — while Always Array holds anything but text
net.noodl.ParseXML.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Turn it into text". Parsing carries on, and a list of names wired in works as the person meant. A one-line change.

net.noodl.SSE.title: Server-Sent Events — Last Error, Retry Count and Duplicates Suppressed change without being sent, so the wire shows stale values
net.noodl.SSE.ruling: R3 (a) — the runtime wins until Richard rules. The spec states the runtime's reading.

net.noodl.SSE.title: Server-Sent Events — Event Types or Method wired a value that is not text throws when the stream connects
net.noodl.SSE.ruling: R3 (a) — the runtime wins until Richard rules; the throw is a known row (conformance.test.ts sseNonText).

net.noodl.SSE.title: Server-Sent Events — after a URL change with Auto Connect off, Connected stays true and Connection State "open" though the stream is gone
net.noodl.SSE.ruling: R3 (a) — the runtime wins until Richard rules. The spec states the runtime's reading.

net.noodl.animatetovalue.title: Animate To Value waits forever when Delay arrives as text or is disconnected
net.noodl.animatetovalue.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Read it as a number". "100" waits 100 ms and a missing Delay starts at once. A one-line change.

net.noodl.controls.button.title: A disabled control still reports Pressed, Pointer Down and Pointer Up for a finger, and Hover for the pointer — Enabled promises it "ignores clicks, touches and typing"
net.noodl.controls.button.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Ignore touches, keep hover". A finger on a disabled control reports nothing, exactly as the description promises.

net.noodl.controls.button.title: Focused (and Hover, Pressed) stay as they were after a control leaves the page with Mounted off — the element that comes back holds no keyboard while Focused still reads true
net.noodl.controls.button.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Reset and announce". The outputs describe the page, and logic waiting for Blurred runs. Small change in shared code, felt by every control.

net.noodl.controls.checkbox.title: A Checkbox whose Label is wired an object or an array crashes the page's render — "Objects are not valid as a React child"
net.noodl.controls.checkbox.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Turn them into text". The page keeps drawing and the label shows the object as text, for example '[object Object]'. That points the person to the mistake.

net.noodl.controls.checkbox.title: A Checkbox loses its root element when Enable Label is turned off — Focus then reports Unchanged, Scroll Into View says it is not mounted, while the box is on the page
net.noodl.controls.checkbox.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Fix it with the label work". Focus and Scroll Into View keep working whatever the label does.

net.noodl.controls.checkbox.title: A Check or Uncheck that reverts a person's click in the same frame does not redraw the Checkbox — the box stays as the click left it and the next click reports the opposite of what the node holds
net.noodl.controls.checkbox.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Draw the last word". The box always shows what the node holds, so an app can refuse or undo a tick and the person sees it.

net.noodl.controls.options.title: A Dropdown whose Items is wired a value that is not a list — the legacy string form included — or a list holding null crashes the page's render
net.noodl.controls.options.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Read old text, else no options". Text in the old format shows its options, other wrong values show an empty Dropdown, and the page keeps drawing.

net.noodl.controls.options.title: A Dropdown's Value written back to the value React last rendered, after a person's pick, changes the output but not the selection shown — picking the shown option again then raises nothing
net.noodl.controls.options.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Fix it now". Every Value from the app moves the selection, including one equal to an earlier write, so a Reset works after a pick.

net.noodl.controls.options.title: A Dropdown fires Changed with nobody picking — a remount, or Items written again after a person's pick, takes the author's Value back and announces it as a change
net.noodl.controls.options.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Fix it now". The pick survives hiding and a refreshed list, and Changed fires only for a person's pick. Small to medium change in the Dropdown's two files.

net.noodl.controls.radiobutton.title: A Radio Button fires Changed when its Checked moves for any reason while its group's last selection was a person's — a sibling carrying the same Value picked, its own Value written in the frame of a pick, a remount after a pick
net.noodl.controls.radiobutton.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Fire from the click". Changed comes from the person's click, and a button that loses the selection to that click reports the deselect.

net.noodl.controls.range.title: A Slider's Value written from the graph after a person's slide does nothing when it equals the last Value the author wrote — the handle stays where the person put it
net.noodl.controls.range.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Fix it now". Every Value from the app moves the handle, so a Reset works after a slide.

net.noodl.controls.range.title: A Slider's Value output disagrees with the handle — it keeps a slid value past a lowered Max, holds a graph value the browser rounds to the step, and Value Percent keeps its old figure when Min or Max moves
net.noodl.controls.range.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Follow the handle".

net.noodl.controls.range.title: A Slider with Min equal to Max reports Value Percent NaN, and every report fires Changed
net.noodl.controls.range.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Percent 0, defaults for blanks". Value Percent reads 0 when Min equals Max, where the browser draws the handle.

net.noodl.controls.range.title: A Slider fires Changed with nobody sliding — a Value written from the graph, a Min or Max that clamps the value, a remount after a slide, and a slider placed with Min equal to Max
net.noodl.controls.range.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Fix it now". Writes from the app move the handle and report Value without Changed, and a hidden Slider keeps its place. Small to medium change in two files.

net.noodl.controls.textinput.title: A mouse press on a Text Input fires no Pointer Down and never sets Pressed — the component's own onMouseDown replaces the control's; a Text Area, a finger and the release still report

Insert Text and Backspace read the field as React last drew it — one arriving in the same frame as a Value, Set, Clear or another edit works on stale text, and a Clear then a Backspace in one frame puts text back

A Text Input's Clear, Backspace and frame-end writes convert with the Type, and measure room with the Max length, the component LAST RENDERED — a Type turned Number with a Clear in the same frame publishes '' where the next frame says null
Turning Enable Label on or off while someone is typing in a Text Input takes the keyboard away from them, silently — React builds a new field under the label, and Focused still says true
net.noodl.controls.textinput.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (R12, NSP-023). Asked in plain words, Richard chose "keeps the keyboard": showing or hiding a label does not touch the field.

net.noodl.controls.textinput.title: Text Input's Set fires Value Changed and reports Done when the field already holds the Value — "Fires whenever the Value output changes" is not what it does
net.noodl.controls.textinput.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), against the recommendation ("Stay quiet, report Unchanged"): "Keep it, fix the description". Nothing changes in apps.

net.noodl.controls.textinput.title: A text-type Text Input given a number publishes '5' (text) while on the page and 5 (a number) while off it — the Value output's type depends on whether the field is mounted
net.noodl.controls.textinput.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Always text". Value has one type whatever the field's visibility. One-word change on the hidden path.

net.noodl.controls.textinput.title: Clear on a Number field reports Unchanged while it empties text the field was holding — it reads the author's Value and the output, not the field
net.noodl.controls.textinput.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-05 (Track F rulings page), as recommended: "Check the field's text". Clear reports Done whenever it empties something. Small change in one file.

net.noodl.controls.textinput.title: A Focus action counts as "a caret someone placed" — on a Text Area an Insert Text then writes at the START of the text, where the browser's resting cursor is, and a field whose Type moved from Email or Number to Text inserts at the start too

net.noodl.user.RequestMagicLink.title: Request Magic Link's Error says "empty until one does" fail and is cleared on a Done — but the clear never reaches a wire, so a label keeps the last failure after a success
net.noodl.user.RequestMagicLink.ruling: R3 (a) — the runtime wins until Richard rules.

net.noodl.user.SignInWith.title: A sign-in cancelled (or refused) at the provider fires Sign In With's Failure twice on the page it returns to — and raises the error twice
net.noodl.user.SignInWith.ruling: R3 (a) — the runtime wins until Richard rules.

net.noodl.user.User.title: On a Directus / PocketBase project, a backend that fails the page-load session check (503, network down) fires Session Lost while the user stays signed in
net.noodl.user.User.ruling: R3 (a) — the runtime wins until Richard rules. The world (world.ts AUTH, THE START-UP CHECK) plays the service as it is.

net.noodl.user.User.title: A session the backend rejects at page load fires Session Lost twice on every User node
net.noodl.user.User.ruling: R3 (a) — the runtime wins until Richard rules.

net.noodl.user.User.title: A User node's `<field> Changed` signals never fire — the editor offers them, nothing registers them (C11 / C37's twin)
net.noodl.user.User.ruling: R3 (a) — the runtime wins until Richard rules; the spec states the pulse, the runtime's silence is a known row.

net.noodl.user.User.title: A signed-in user with Roles makes every User node pulse Changed on every session read — three times per Fetch — when nothing changed
net.noodl.user.User.ruling: R3 (a) — the runtime wins until Richard rules.

net.noodl.visual.columns.title: A number wired into a Columns' Medium Below or Small Below is refused unless a size was typed into that port first, and a number after a var(--token) is refused on any size port
net.noodl.visual.columns.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as recommended: "Read the number as pixels". A bare number on a size input that holds no size, or last held a token, is read in the input's default unit.

net.noodl.visual.columns.title: A Columns whose Medium Layout or Small Layout holds a number (or any value that is not a string) blanks the page when the container narrows into that band
net.noodl.visual.columns.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as recommended: "Read a number as its text, and anything else as no layout". As Layout String already does.

net.noodl.visual.columns.title: A Columns on Auto Fit whose Min Column Width plus Horizontal Gap is 0 (Min 16, Gap −16) blanks the page — the column count divides by zero
net.noodl.visual.columns.ruling: Ruled 2026-10-08 (P107 "Phase 107 Rulings" page), as recommended: "Treat it as one column, and never draw more columns than there are children".
